search.title: Model Context Protocol
search.snippet: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard introduced by Anthropic in November 2024 for connecting AI assistants to external data sources and tools.

search.title: Anthropic
search.snippet: In November 2024 Anthropic released the Model Context Protocol, an open standard for tool use by large language models, and donated it to the Linux Foundation in 2025.

search.title: Language model & tool use
search.snippet: Function calling lets a model invoke external tools. The Model Context Protocol generalises this into a transport-agnostic client/server interface.
